text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Have you seen the tree in the courtyard? 
Something wonderful is happening to it 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, there was a ribbon caught in a 
tree. It looked worn and faded, as if it 
had drifted in from somewhere far away.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It was hanging there half-caught, which 
looked rather lonely... So I tied it back 
onto the branch, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When I looked this morning, so many 
ribbons were connected together... forming 
a giant circle!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So many people must have tied these with 
all sorts of heartfelt wishes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There are so many wonderful circles of 
friends at this academy...♪
